fallbacks.subagents: Sequential fresh-context review using the exact base..head package; report degraded independence.
fallbacks.browser_verification: Capture screenshot or page text evidence and record automated assertions as Not Run.
fallbacks.human_approval_gates: Halt, print the exact pending action, and require an explicit human reply.

install: Commit Manus.md and manually provide BOOTSTRAP.md or reference it at session start.
rollback: Restore the previous revision from version control.
limitations: Automatic session-start ingestion is not established. Activation is Manual and must never be reported as enforced.
deprecation: None. Adapter is active but requires per-session activation.
